exercises.name: Archer push-ups (assisted if needed)
exercises.cue: Unilateral chest strength; assess clean reps first.

exercises.name: Deep parallettes push-ups
exercises.cue: Control the descent and avoid forcing shoulder depth.

exercises.name: Uneven push-ups
exercises.cue: Keep hips and torso stable.

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.cue: Keep elbows controlled near the torso.

exercises.name: Back widows
exercises.cue: Press elbows into the floor to lift upper torso slightly.

exercises.name: Self-resisted single-arm rows
exercises.cue: Opposite hand resists the pulling arm throughout.

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.cue: Lift arms with control; keep neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W raises
exercises.cue: Pause briefly in each Y, T and W position.

exercises.name: Bird dogs
exercises.cue: Keep hips level while reaching opposite arm and leg.

exercises.name: L-sit holds on low parallettes
exercises.cue: Straight knees and active shoulder depression.

exercises.name: Seated pike compression lifts
exercises.cue: Start bent-knee if straight-leg lifts are not yet clean.

exercises.name: Reverse crunches
exercises.cue: Curl pelvis without swinging legs.

exercises.name: Hollow body holds
exercises.cue: Keep low back gently connected to floor.

exercises.name: Side planks
exercises.cue: Stack hips and shoulders; keep body long.

exercises.name: Assisted pistol squats
exercises.cue: Hold a sturdy chair back beside you; press through the foot to rise.

exercises.name: Slow reverse lunges
exercises.cue: Use a 3-second descent and keep hips stable.

exercises.name: Hamstring walkouts
exercises.cue: Keep hips raised as heels walk away.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridges
exercises.cue: Lift from the glute and keep pelvis level.

exercises.name: Side-lying adductor raises
exercises.cue: Lift the lower leg slowly.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abductions
exercises.cue: Keep hips stacked while raising the top leg.

exercises.name: Straight-knee single-leg calf raises
exercises.cue: Pause at the top; lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.cue: Keep a soft knee bend through the raise.

exercises.name: Tuck planche holds
exercises.cue: Straight elbows; push actively through the low parallettes.

exercises.name: Planche leans
exercises.cue: Keep elbows straight and shoulders protracted.

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.cue: Press through shoulders with control.

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.cue: Keep elbows straight and move the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Parallettes support holds
exercises.cue: Press down and keep shoulders depressed.
